brand.about: LB's comes from Limon Bandits — a creative world built around music, culture and individuality. We wanted to bring that energy off the stage and into a space where everyone could hang out, eat, create, connect and simply be themselves. Our menu blends comfort, creativity and unexpected flavours, while the space brings together retro nostalgia with a modern edge.
brand.welcome: A café born from the world of Limon Bandits, where food, music, art and culture collide. LB's is built for the curious, the creative and the unapologetically different. From comfort food and experimental drinks to late-night conversations and good music, this is more than a place to eat — it's a place to belong.
